bible.summary: Soviet kitchen: doorway to the lit hallway on the far left, wall clock, old ZiL fridge covered in magnets, a note and a child's drawing with a radio on top, small table with a checked oilcloth, teapot and cups under the window to the yard (café curtains, flowers and a jar on the sill) with a stool on each side, tear-off calendar, wall cabinet with dishes, utensil rail with ladle and garlic over the tiles, stove with a kettle, steaming pot and a towel on the right; tiled linoleum floor.
bible.prompt: small cosy kitchen, table with tea cups, old fridge, stove, window with curtains
